tips.text: Buy every beacon you need before the series ends; unspent Cred turns into a sellable item and the store closes.
Spend leftover Cred on beacons once you have what you want from the store.
Shoot the body with high crit instead of the head, and bring Radiation or Corrosive with armor strip or a buffing frame like Rhino.
Skip Steel Path for this; it doubles resources and mods, not weapon parts.
Go invisible with Loki, Ivara's Prowl or an Octavia Metronome specter; he does not attack invisible Tenno.
Use the beacon in a low-level mission so he is easier to kill; solo is fine.
Stay airborne with Zephyr, Titania's Razorwing or Hildryn's Aegis Storm; his melee reaches fliers badly.
Do not start in a weak squad; he stays after a wipe or when the beacon user leaves, so a slow kill fails the mission.
Leave Nekros at home for this; the Wolf leaves no corpse for Desecrate.
Ignore the temporary unranked Wolf Sledge from the Halikar; it gives no Mastery.
Players now finish in under 15 beacons and mostly treat the hammer as a mastery pickup.
